results.query: ongoing acetylene generation active arcing transformer removed from service ppm per month
results.snippet: Any ongoing acetylene (C2H2) generation indicates an active arcing fault, and the transformer may have to be removed from service to avoid possible catastrophic failure. A transformer may be safely operated with some C2H2 showing in the DGA. C2H2 sometimes comes from a one-time event such as a close-in lightning strike or through fault. However, if C2H2 is increasing more than 10 ppm per month, the transformer should be removed from service.
